numbering: Episodes numbered 1-12; the recap special that aired between episodes 4 and 5 is unnumbered.

arcs.name: Tokyo Outbreak
arcs.summary: Burned-out office worker Akira Tendo wakes up to a zombie apocalypse and feels free for the first time in years. He decides to spend the end of the world crossing off a bucket list.
events: Akira finally quits his exploitative job and writes a list of 100 things to do before he dies.
He reunites with his best friend Kencho, who confesses he dreams of doing stand-up comedy.
Akira teams up with the cautious survivor Shizuka.

arcs.name: Road Trip of the Dead
arcs.summary: With an RV and a growing crew, Akira's group sets off across Japan looking for new bucket-list adventures.
events: The group falls into the hands of Gonzou's gang at a truck stop.
Akira finally stands up to Gonzou with Shizuka's help.
German tourist Beatrix joins the group after a sushi feast.
They help a man named Kumano build a treehouse before heading to Akira's hometown.

arcs.name: Hometown of the Dead
arcs.summary: Akira returns to his rural home village, which has walled itself off from the outbreak, only for outsiders to threaten it.
events: Higurashi's group breaks the tunnel barrier and lets zombies into the village.
Akira outwits Higurashi, the bridge is saved, and the group prepares to move on.

filler.note: No filler: every numbered episode adapts the manga (the August 2023 recap special is unnumbered).
